epoch_boundary_aligned.meaning: the exact end timestamp of the previous epoch aligns with the start of the new epoch
epoch_boundary_aligned.checkpoint: before claimRewards() for the previous epoch

claim_previous_epoch.meaning: a user calls claimRewards() to claim rewards for the previous epoch (currentEpoch - 1)

deposit_before_epoch_end.meaning: a deposit transaction is executed right before the epoch concludes

attacker_reward_share.meaning: share of the previous epoch rewards extracted by the attacker who deposited only at the epoch boundary
attacker_reward_share.checkpoint: after claimRewards() for the previous epoch

honest_continuous_share.meaning: share of the previous epoch rewards attributable to users who held liquidity risk continuously across the entire epoch
honest_continuous_share.checkpoint: after claimRewards() for the previous epoch

claims.scope: claimRewards reward eligibility based on userBondedBalanceAtEpochEnd snapshot

preconditions.text: The exact end timestamp of the previous epoch aligns with the start of the new epoch.; A user calls claimRewards() to claim rewards for the previous epoch (currentEpoch - 1).; An attacker can execute a deposit transaction right before the epoch concludes.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: Rewards for the previous epoch should be claimable only proportional to a user's locked deposits held continuously across that entire epoch, not merely at its end timestamp.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: The attacker extracts a massive share of the rewards, directly diluting users who held liquidity risk for the entire epoch.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The attacker's deposit and the claimRewards() call concern the same previous epoch (currentEpoch - 1).
claimRewards() is callable by the attacker without additional authorization not described in the report.
Reward shares are comparable integer quantities in the same reward_share unit.

limitations: Only the i_dilute_honest impact is formalized; i_steal_rewards is deferred to a future claim.
The proportional_fairness relation is symbolic because the report supplies no numeric reward-share values.
Whether the deposit and claimRewards() occur in the same transaction/block is not specified and is not encoded.
Permissionlessness of claimRewards() is assumed, not stated in the report.
